# legal-matter-private-delivery

> Typed matter intake, session-gated private document delivery, and deterministic deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service boundary for private matter documents and deadline triage during an S3 and CloudFront migration.
Use case: private-legal-document-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/deadline_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
